title: Product Public Web Dependency Security Upgrade and Next.js Runtime Validation
summary: Upgrades the public web dependency stack to Next.js 16.2.10 with a minimal PostCSS 8.5.10 override, keeps React 18.3.1, closes npm audit findings and validates Docker runtime, nginx routes, static assets and update-apply test consistency.
changelog: Upgrades the KM VMS web runtime from Next.js 14.2.28 to Next.js 16.2.10.
Keeps React and React DOM on 18.3.1 while preserving the existing frontend behavior.
Adds a minimal PostCSS 8.5.10 npm override to close the residual production audit finding.
Closes full and production npm audit findings for the public web dependency stack.
Validates Docker web/nginx runtime, Settings and Storage routes, health checks and static assets.
Aligns update-apply focused tests with the current macro-step progress model.
